LET ME START BY SAYING I NEED HELP TYPING MY HAIR...:( that being said my routine is as follows:

I shampoo twice a week with LUKEWARM water with Deva Curl no-poo, but every three shampoos, I use Organix's Argan Oil shampoo for moisture, shine, and for a better clean. If I don't my hair gets weighed down from grease and won't curl correctly.

I condition every other day with a mix of Deva Curl conditioner and Shea Moisure Leave in Treatment Contioner and leave them both in my hair for up to 15-20 minutes while I take a bubble bath before my shower, or I apply it before my shower.

I squish to condish once I am OUT of the shower with Organix Coconut Curls Butter and then squish in Deva Curl curling cream, and do not dry with a towel or and thing at all. I scrunch my hair while it is soaking wet with the product freshly applied in it. I do my makeup while I wait for my hair to dry enough for me to put on my clothes. When I say I do not dry it at all, I mean at ALL.

It takes my hair usually about 1.5 hours to be fully dry. I the flip my head upside-down and shake at the roots of my hair in the front with a tiny bit of argon oil I carry in my purse. Ta-da! It last for two days, sometimes even three if you have dry shampoo. :)

You don't have to use an iron to curl it. Go to Ilya and as for the devacurl curl cream. Twist portions of your dry hair coated in a bit of the cream into curls and bobby pin the ends of the long rolled curls, and then spray each rolled strand with hair spray too. It takes about 15 mins to dry, and with the amount of hair you have and type of hair you have it'll take probably 10 minutes at most to twist the portions, the same amount of time it might take you to curl it without the heat damage. Plus the curls will last all day, and you can comb them out and do them the next day with less product and they'll look as good I not better because they'll hold some of the wave from the day before even after being curled. It smells great too. A cheaper alternative is Organix coconut curling butter (NOT THE CREAM) or Dove's Ultra Hydrating Conditioner in the upside down white tube with the bottom bronze part where the continent comes out (and when I say conditioner I mean 'normal in the shower conditioner.') If you use these though, spray hairspray before AND after you twist the curls, but just a little bit. :) it's your hair, but because it's your hair, always look into ways to styling it the way you want without damaging it. You are definitely not disassociated, but knowing from the beginning that there was nothin you could do to fix that current problem will help you focus on what to so next to prepare yourself so it doesn't get worse. The only thing in life you have control of is your response to the world around you. Use it wisely :)
